question: v05
q: Petrol's killing me. How much more am I paying than a year ago?

transcript.answer:
Automotive fuel prices are **13.5% higher** than a year ago. The ABS Consumer Price Index for August 2026 (the latest monthly figure) shows the fuel index at 112.95, up from 99.49 in August 2025.

That's a percentage, not a dollar figure. The CPI doesn't give litre prices, so I can't say exactly how many cents more you're paying per litre. If you tell me what you paid a year ago, I can work out the dollar difference.

The year has been bumpy. Fuel prices jumped 24.2% over the year to March 2026 and 18.6% to April, then eased to -7.3% by June before rising again to +13.5% in August. The August jump is the most recent move, so prices have swung back up sharply.
